messages:
Priya: Heads-up — WaveLabs wants to push their renewal up to next week. They also need the invoice split across two legal entities and are asking for a 'digital witnessing' attestation on the eSign. Procurement flagged this. cc @Samir @Ellen
Samir: Digital witnessing — do they mean notarization or just a witness signer + audit log? :thinking:
Ellen: For invoice split we can do 70/30 across two entities, but we need vendor codes + PO number for the PO side. Payment method matters (CC vs PO).
Priya: They said CC for Entity A and PO for Entity B. Procurement insists the PO-backed invoice needs evidence of a witnessed signature. They pasted this clause in their appendix: ```witnessing_clause: "electronic witnessing accepted where platform provides identity logs and signer attestation"```
Samir: That's manageable. Our standard is: certificate of completion + identity verification (email/sms) retained. For a witness we can add a witness role in the envelope so the witness signs second. I'll draft a one-line addendum to call this out.
Jordan: I can collect witness details from the customer. Quick question — will a virtual witnessed Teams call + witness attestation PDF satisfy them if DocuSign witness role isn't possible?
Samir: Legal preference is DocuSign witness role + certificate, but if the customer needs a backup we can accept a recorded witness call plus a signed attestation PDF as long as we store logs. Need to capture identity (name + email).
DocusignBot: Envelope #78941 created by Priya for WaveLabs renewal. Status: sent.
Priya: Thanks. Jordan — customer gave us a witness name: Marta Ruiz (procurement). Can you confirm CC details for Entity A so finance can provision pre-auth?
Jordan: Confirmed — Marta Ruiz is the witness. Entity A (CC) will pay via card; Entity B will issue PO #WL-PO-9921. I'll send the secure card link and request PO upload.
Ellen: Finance: once envelope completes we need the certificate of completion + the invoice split CSV (entity, amount, vendor code). If they pay CC we can process immediately; PO side needs vendor code before we invoice.
Samir: Draft addendum for review: ```Addendum: Electronic witnessing performed via DocuSign Witness Role and Certificate of Completion, or alternatively a recorded witness call plus signed attestation, shall be deemed equivalent to a witnessed signature for purposes of this agreement.```
Priya: LGTM Samir. Ellen — please confirm vendor code requirements so Jordan can chase PO details. We want billing to hit next week's cut.
Ellen: Vendor code + PO number required in metadata. Also need remit-to for Entity B. Tag billing@sources when ready.
Jordan: I'll collect PO + remit-to today and update the envelope if needed. Sending witness availability options now.
Priya: Great — once signed, upload certificate + invoice split to billing and loop me. Thanks team :tada:
Jordan: Will do. :thumbsup:
Priya: Closing loop — I'll post when envelope is completed and invoices queued.
